premises.text: Streaming economics make it very hard for artists to earn a living, while fans who want to support artists lack a direct mobile path to do so for live music
premises.evidence_span: Nearly a generation has grown up assuming music is or should be free. And this has made it very hard for artists to make a living today

premises.text: Spacebar streams live audio performances to mobile devices worldwide at high bitrate, with free previews and paid listen-in for remote fans
premises.evidence_span: Space Bar streams live audio performances to mobile devices

premises.text: Live-listen data gives bands and venues business intelligence for planning tours and booking acts
premises.evidence_span: This is new data that the bands had never seen before, emerging bands had never seen before. And it will help them plan their tours

premises.text: Launch via influential NYC clubs plus a Backplane partnership to reach large artist fan communities at scale
premises.evidence_span: we're delighted to launch Space Bar from some of the most influential clubs in New York City

premises.text: A simple one-button broadcast architecture lets any artist go live and scale to superstar audiences
premises.evidence_span: We crafted a beautifully simple architecture that just works so that when superstars take the stage, they can reach out to all of their fans all over the world

domains.name: broken artist livelihood and fan support

value.text: Fans experience live shows remotely while supporting artists, and artists better connect with fans
value.evidence_span: help musicians to better connect with their fans and to build a mobile platform to help those fans that wish to support artists to directly do so

secondary_value.text: Venues and bands get listenership intelligence for booking and touring
secondary_value.evidence_span: It's business intelligence that will help venues book the hottest new acts

causal_links.evidence_span: what I want as an artist is to rock out live on stage
For 99 cents, it's as though I'm there
look for Spacebar to be streaming Lady Gaga to her team of little monsters

notes: Stream-count wage math folded into artist-income problem (§4.1.6). Previews, 99¢ listen-in, and one-button broadcast folded as live-streaming product cascade; listenership analytics kept as package of that product (§4.1.7–8). Club roster and artist signup counts treated as traction for GTM. Closing live performance ignored as demo content. Market-size of clubs/festivals treated as framing.
